acceptance: DataFusion and Spark-compatible DataFrame engines with native plans capture and persist semantically structured plans where a compatible parser exists; resolve PySpark registry naming and LakeSail/Databricks callable-path gaps.

Supported DataFrame plans survive export/load and are usable by common display/comparison consumers; top-level fingerprints and optional normalized fingerprints are propagated when a canonical DAG exists.

Polars raw plans remain inspectable with explicit raw-only capability semantics unless a real structured parser is implemented; unsupported eager engines report unsupported rather than a fabricated plan.
Behavioral tests execute representative supported DataFrame queries and check result/plan identity, timing isolation, fingerprints and round trips; docs reflect the actual engine-specific contract.
context:
Static source assessment on 2026-10-28. Scope is native-capability integration and truthful parity, not adding an optimizer to Pandas/Dask/cuDF. Sequenced after error accounting because both edit profiling.py and benchmark_mixin.py.

Guardrails: no live cloud (Databricks) execution; prove the Databricks callable path with a local SparkSession substitute only where the adapter's own code path runs unmodified, otherwise cover it with a behavioral unit test and state the limit. LakeSail requires the pysail package (not installed): wire the route and test with local PySpark-compatible behavior, stating the limit. Adapter SDK imports stay lazy. Plan capture time stays excluded from measured execution time (qpc-09).

Verification rubric: (1) focused regression test fails before the change and passes after; (2) uv run -- python -m pytest -n 0 on the touched plan test modules passes; (3) make comment-policy-check and ruff/typecheck on touched files pass; (4) a runtime smoke on the real surface described in acceptance is recorded in the PR body.
description: DataFrame capture uses a separate raw QueryPlan wrapper and optional registry promotion, not the SQL result contract. DataFusion can promote to QueryPlanDAG, while Polars remains raw and PySpark uses platform=pyspark although its parser is registered as spark. The shared dispatch does not recognize LakeSail; Databricks callable queries bypass inherited SQL capture. The mixin attaches query_plan/capture_time but not top-level plan_fingerprint fields. Define a capability-specific contract and complete supported lazy-engine routes without inventing fake optimizer plans for eager Pandas-family engines.
